meta.description: Turn plugin/templates/tasks-dashboard.html into a tested Svelte 5 project (dashboard/) whose single-file build populates the plugin folder. Regression tests against the legacy v0.4.0 dashboard come first and act as the parity oracle. Full plan: docs/svelte-migration-plan.md.

tasks.name: Stash zoom/pan WIP and create migration branch
tasks.description: Stash the uncommitted zoom/pan/minimap work as 'zoom-pan-minimap wip' (git stash) so the regression baseline is the committed v0.4.0 dashboard. Create branch dev/svelte-dashboard.

tasks.name: Add migration plan and dogfood task list to docs/
tasks.description: Add docs/svelte-migration-plan.md (the approved plan), docs/tasks.json (this file) and docs/tasks-dashboard.html (copy of the v0.4.0 dashboard) so the migration can be run with /atm:do-task and /atm:loop-tasks and watched via `cd docs && python3 -m http.server 8000`.

tasks.name: Scaffold dashboard/ with Vite, Svelte 5 and TypeScript
tasks.description: Create dashboard/ (not shipped; plugin source is ./plugin) with package.json, vite.config.ts, svelte.config.js, tsconfig.json, index.html (keeping <meta name="atm-dashboard-version">), src/main.ts and a placeholder App.svelte. Use Svelte 5 runes. Add dashboard/node_modules, dist, test-results and playwright-report to .gitignore. `npm run dev` should serve the placeholder.

tasks.name: Single-file build to dashboard/dist with version injection
tasks.description: Add vite-plugin-singlefile so `npm run build` emits one self-contained dashboard/dist/tasks-dashboard.html (no external JS/CSS). Add a small Vite plugin (transformIndexHtml) that reads the version from plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and writes it into the atm-dashboard-version meta tag. Do NOT write to plugin/templates yet; that happens at cutover (T-023).

tasks.name: Configure Vitest with coverage and testing-library
tasks.description: Set up Vitest (jsdom) with @testing-library/svelte and @vitest/coverage-v8. Coverage threshold: 90% lines on src/lib/**. Tests live in dashboard/tests/unit/. Add `npm test` and `npm run test:coverage`. Include one trivial passing test to prove the setup.

tasks.name: Playwright harness with legacy and svelte projects
tasks.description: Freeze the current shipped dashboard as dashboard/tests/legacy/tasks-dashboard.v0.4.0.html. Configure playwright.config.ts: Chromium only, fixed viewport, webServer serving a static dir; two projects running the same specs, `legacy` (frozen file) and `svelte` (dashboard/dist/tasks-dashboard.html), selected via a per-project baseURL/path. Add tests/e2e/helpers.ts with useFixture(page, name) that serves tests/fixtures/<name>.json for **/tasks.json via page.route (and can swap the response or return 404), plus an auto fixture that fails the test on any non-localhost request. snapshotPathTemplate must omit the project name so svelte compares against legacy screenshots. Add `npm run test:e2e`.

tasks.name: Lint, format, svelte-check, npm scripts and root CLAUDE.md
tasks.description: Add ESLint (flat config, eslint-plugin-svelte, typescript-eslint), Prettier (+ prettier-plugin-svelte) and svelte-check. Scripts: dev, build, test, test:coverage, test:e2e, check (svelte-check + eslint + prettier --check), verify (check + test + build + test:e2e). Add a repo-root CLAUDE.md describing the dev workflow, the plugin vs dashboard split, and that plugin/templates/tasks-dashboard.html is a build artifact (after cutover).

tasks.name: Create tasks.json test fixtures
tasks.description: In dashboard/tests/fixtures/: empty.json, minimal.json (1 task), standard.json (all 7 types x 5 statuses, 3 phases, deps, use_cases/requirements/files, created_at/updated_at timestamps), cycle.json (dependency cycle), edge-cases.json (unknown type and status, dependency on a missing ID, tasks without timestamps, very long names, unicode, HTML like bold in name and description), no-meta.json (no meta block). Add tests/fixtures/generate-large.mjs that deterministically writes large-90.json (90 tasks, wide graph, ~40 done, 1 in_progress), and commit its output.

tasks.name: Regression specs: load, stats, timeline
tasks.description: tests/e2e/load.spec.ts and stats.spec.ts, green on the legacy project. Load: page title and #dashboard-title use meta.project, subtitle counts tasks and phases, no-meta falls back to 'Task Dashboard', a 404 for tasks.json shows the 'Failed to load tasks.json' box with python3 -m http.server instructions. Stats: Total/Done/In Progress/Todo numbers, Blocked card only when blocked > 0, per-type count cards, progress %. Timeline: shown only when tasks have timestamps, bucket count clamped to 4-16, start/end date labels, tooltip appears on bar hover.

tasks.name: Regression specs: filters and task cards
tasks.description: tests/e2e/filters.spec.ts and cards.spec.ts, green on legacy. Filters: generated phase/type/status buttons (.filter-btn[data-filter][data-value]), status order todo,in_progress,done,blocked,skipped, capitalized labels, multi-select is OR within a group and AND across groups, 'All' clears the group, active classes stay in sync, 'N of M shown' text, empty-result message in both the card grid and the graph. Cards: .task-card[data-id] with phase/type/status badges, 'needs:' dependency links scroll to and highlight the target card, UC and requirement tags.

tasks.name: Regression specs: detail panel and dependency graph
tasks.description: tests/e2e/detail.spec.ts and graph.spec.ts, green on legacy. Detail: opens from a card name and from a graph node (#detail-overlay.open), shows description, UCs, requirements, timestamps, files, 'Depends On' and 'Required By' entries that navigate to the other task; closes via the x button, an overlay click and Escape. Graph: one node per filtered task, edge count matches visible dependencies, #graph-badge says 'N tasks', cycle.json still renders every node, header click collapses and expands the graph.

tasks.name: Regression specs: reload, auto-refresh, edge cases
tasks.description: tests/e2e/refresh.spec.ts and edge-cases.spec.ts, green on legacy. Refresh: #reload-btn re-fetches and re-renders after the fixture response is swapped; #auto-refresh-check plus #auto-refresh-interval polls on the configured interval (use page.clock); active filters survive a reload. Edge cases: unknown type/status render with fallback styles, a dependency on a missing ID does not crash, long names are truncated to 22 chars in graph nodes. XSS divergence: a test asserting task text is rendered as literal text (not HTML) is marked test.fail() for the legacy project only, with a comment explaining the svelte port fixes it.

tasks.name: Visual baseline screenshots from legacy
tasks.description: tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts: toHaveScreenshot for full page, graph section and open detail panel on standard, large-90, empty and edge-cases fixtures. Generate baselines from the legacy project only (--project=legacy --update-snapshots) and commit them. Use a small maxDiffPixelRatio. Afterwards the whole suite must be green on legacy; commit this before any app code (phase 3+).

tasks.name: Port types, theme and loader to src/lib
tasks.description: Create src/lib/types.ts (Task, TasksFile, Status, TaskType), src/lib/theme.ts (TYPE_COLORS, STATUS_COLORS, PHASE_PALETTE, FALLBACK_TYPE, type/status emoji maps, phaseColor/typeStyle/statusStyle, lifted from the legacy inline script) and src/lib/load.ts (fetch ./tasks.json?<timestamp>, return tasks, taskMap and projectName, or a typed error). Unit tests for the style fallbacks and the loader (mock fetch, including HTTP error and no-meta).

tasks.name: Port filter and stats logic with unit tests
tasks.description: src/lib/filters.ts: filter option derivation (sorted phases, sorted types, statuses in the legacy order with unknowns last, label capitalization) and filterTasks (OR within group, AND across groups, empty set = all), matching legacy buildFilters/filterTasks. src/lib/stats.ts: totals, per-status and per-type counts, progress % as legacy renderStats computes it. Characterization unit tests for both.

tasks.name: Port timeline bucketing with unit tests
tasks.description: src/lib/timeline.ts: completion events from done tasks' timestamps, bucket count clamped to 4-16, bucket assignment, min/max range and date formatting, matching the legacy timeline code in renderStats. Unit tests including no timestamps, single completion and identical timestamps.

tasks.name: Port dependency graph layout with unit tests
tasks.description: src/lib/graph/layout.ts: topological layering of the filtered tasks (only visible deps count; a cycle dumps the remaining tasks into one layer), node positions (nodeW 160, nodeH 52, padX 60, padY 24, layers vertically centered), edge list with bezier path data, total width/height and truncate(name, 22), matching legacy renderDepGraph. Unit tests: chain, diamond, cycle, hidden deps, empty input.

tasks.name: App shell, global styles, state, Header, Stats, Timeline
tasks.description: Move the legacy CSS over verbatim (global stylesheet first; scope into components later only if screenshots stay green). src/lib/state.svelte.ts holds tasks, taskMap, filters and autoRefresh with runes. Components Header, Stats and Timeline keep the legacy DOM contract (ids/classes the e2e specs use). Build to dashboard/dist and run the load/stats specs on the svelte project.

tasks.name: Filters, refresh controls, task grid and cards
tasks.description: Components Filters, RefreshControls (reload button, auto toggle, interval), TaskGrid and TaskCard, preserving the DOM contract (.filter-btn[data-filter][data-value], .task-card[data-id], #reload-btn, #auto-refresh-check, #auto-refresh-interval). Task text is rendered escaped (Svelte default). filters/cards/refresh specs pass on the svelte project.

tasks.name: Detail panel component
tasks.description: DetailPanel component with #detail-overlay/#detail-panel, Depends On / Required By navigation, close via x, overlay click and Escape. The detail spec passes on the svelte project.

tasks.name: Dependency graph component
tasks.description: DepGraph component rendering src/lib/graph/layout.ts output as SVG with the legacy look (viewBox scaling as in v0.4.0; zoom/pan comes in phase 6), node click opens details, collapsible header with #graph-badge. The graph spec passes on the svelte project.

tasks.name: Full parity with legacy plus component tests
tasks.description: The entire e2e suite, including visual screenshots, passes on both the legacy and svelte projects (the XSS test passes on svelte). Add @testing-library/svelte component tests for TaskCard and Filters. Fix any differences in the port, not by loosening tests; any intentional difference must be documented in the spec. Then switch the test:e2e script from --project=legacy to both projects (until parity it runs legacy only so npm run verify stays green; test:e2e:svelte and test:e2e:all exist for porting work).

tasks.name: Cut over: build into plugin/templates, guardrails, pre-commit hook
tasks.description: Switch build.outDir to ../plugin/templates (emptyOutDir: false so templates/tasks.json survives) and point the svelte Playwright project there. Add guardrail tests: the built file references no external URLs and stays under 150 KB. Add a pre-commit hook (simple-git-hooks + lint-staged, scoped to dashboard/**) that rebuilds and stages plugin/templates/tasks-dashboard.html. Commit the built file.

tasks.name: GitHub Actions CI
tasks.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml on push and PR: npm ci in dashboard/, npm run check, unit tests with coverage threshold, build then `git diff --exit-code plugin/templates/tasks-dashboard.html` (check-dist pattern; CI never commits), Playwright e2e (install browsers, upload report on failure), and a version-consistency script asserting plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json versions match.

tasks.name: Bump to 0.5.0 and document development workflow
tasks.description: Bump plugin.json and marketplace.json to 0.5.0 and rebuild (the dashboard version comes from plugin.json). README: add a Development section (dashboard/ layout, npm scripts, fixtures, legacy vs svelte Playwright projects, the built file is committed and checked by CI) and update Project Structure.

tasks.name: Re-baseline screenshots from svelte and retire legacy project
tasks.description: Once CI is green with both projects, regenerate screenshot baselines from the svelte project, remove the legacy Playwright project and the legacy-only test.fail annotation. Keep tests/legacy/tasks-dashboard.v0.4.0.html for reference.

tasks.name: Write failing zoom/pan/minimap tests
tasks.description: Test-first. tests/e2e/graph-zoom.spec.ts: large-90 opens at >=60% centered on the in-progress task; a small graph opens at 100% centered; dragging pans without opening details; a plain node click opens details; Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms around the cursor; the -, +, fit and 1:1 buttons and the + - 0 F and arrow keys work; the minimap appears only when the graph overflows and click/drag moves the view; the view persists across reload and resets when filters change. tests/unit/view.test.ts for fit, clamp and zoom-at-point. These must fail before T-028.

tasks.name: Implement zoom, pan and minimap
tasks.description: Implement src/lib/graph/view.ts plus GraphControls and Minimap components and update DepGraph to a fixed-height pan/zoom viewport, porting the logic from `git stash show -p stash^{/zoom-pan-minimap}` (applyGraphView, fitGraph, autoFitGraph, zoomGraphAt, the minimap and pointer handling with click suppression after a drag). Make T-027 pass; update screenshot baselines for the graph intentionally.

tasks.name: Release zoom/pan as 0.6.0 and drop the stash
tasks.description: Bump to 0.6.0, rebuild, add the dependency graph controls to the README dashboard features list, and drop the 'zoom-pan-minimap wip' stash once everything is merged.
